en.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
en.summary: NVIDIA's November 12 announcement states that Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and director. Colette Kress was appointed interim CEO while remaining CFO; Harvey C. Jones was appointed board chair. A permanent CEO search was initiated.

zh.title: NVIDIA 宣布 CEO 过渡安排
zh.summary: NVIDIA 11月12日公告称，黄仁勋辞去总裁、CEO及董事职务；Colette Kress 出任临时 CEO 并继续担任 CFO，Harvey C. Jones 出任董事会主席，公司启动常任 CEO 遴选。
